fact: A Ministry of Information adviser, writing in a personal capacity, says Somalia has an E-Transactions Law moving through the legislative process, alongside a Data Protection Act and a Cybersecurity Bill; no date is given for the stage reached, so as_of is the document's published date.

Somalia's Ministry of Communications and Technology says the House of the People approved the Digital Transactions Bill, a legal framework governing digital transactions, with 137 votes in favour; Senate stage and assent are not stated.
